name: CampHawk Quick Cart
description: When you tap a CampHawk alert, optionally auto-fill dates and add the site to your cart on Recreation.gov or ReserveCalifornia — in your own browser session.

content_scripts.comment: MAIN world at document_start: RC's auth token is Okta-encrypted in localStorage and only ever decrypted in page JS, so rc-inject.js wraps XHR/fetch to capture the live `accesstoken` header off RC's own calls. An isolated-world script cannot see it, and starting later misses the calls that carry it.
Isolated world, document_idle: reads the #camphawk-rc fragment, draws the banner, and POSTs the add-to-cart using the token rc-inject.js hands over via postMessage.
